exposure: Implementation of a centralized national placenta accreta spectrum care system involving a multidisciplinary team
outcome: Number of patients taken to surgery with suspected placenta accreta spectrum
False positives in prenatal and intraoperative diagnosis
False negatives in prenatal and intraoperative diagnosis
cohort: The study involved patients with placenta accreta spectrum in Nicaragua.
finding: The implementation of a centralized placenta accreta spectrum care system by a trained multidisciplinary team was associated with better clinical outcomes, including reductions in false positives/negatives, transfusions, hysterectomy rates, and ICU admissions.
